newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares end flat, Luka Koper dominates.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares end flat, Luka Koper dominates.

text.p: 1320 GMT -- Slovenian shares end barely changed on Wednesday with market activity centring on debut of port Luker Koper.
Traders say future performance of Luka Koper, which fell on its debut, depends upon whether the state allows foreign investors to purchase the port's shares.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 0.52 points to 1,145.1.
* Luka Koper was by far the most actively traded, closing at 2,200 tolars after opening at 2,600 on volume of 58,398 shares.
* Overall seven shares fell, six rose and three remained unchanged, while another eight were untraded.
